scope: Five-flow pilot first-prompt/reload child only. Other CHAT-01 variants are deferred, not pilot prerequisites; cancellation and streaming have their own selected pilot cases.
deferredVariants: Pending/stale/out-of-order/reconnect/multi-session and responsive/theme child variants outside the selected first-prompt/reload child
expectation: I can ask this question once, follow a coherent response that visibly belongs to it, understand what the app is doing at every step, and return to the same trustworthy conversation after reload without lost or displaced work.
userGoals: Submit one prompt, receive the correctly associated answer 46, and retain that exact conversation after reload
preconditions: Exact deployed Watai origin and actual approved frontend/API identities; no local app, mocked requests, fabricated responses or token injection
Genuine designated invited non-admin test identity, protected session, verified immutable owner and consent/configuration state
Real configured provider, one-submission authority and independently enforced provider spend ceiling
Verified existing Edge page with the designated account; preserve and record actual viewport, scale, locale and theme/fonts without emulation, cloning or foreground focus
New empty /#/new conversation with zero data-message-id nodes; existing history blocks rather than being deleted
Complete capture, heuristic, skill/model/runtime, privacy, evidence storage and independent calibration prerequisites validated before launch
safety: Exactly one Send action and one POST run submission; no automatic resend, regeneration, tool confirmation or cleanup deletion
Only fixed approved app/API/identity/realtime origins, at most120 requests and20MiB decoded traffic; browser task90seconds maximum
No foreground focus, user profile takeover, forced click, alternate selector or invented capture phase
Record only fixed non-sensitive prompt/reply and whitelisted run/message identities; never credentials, headers, cookies, storage, URL queries, execution tokens or arbitrary response bodies
Unexpected account, pre-existing history, ambiguous acceptance, unplanned provider work or evidence loss stops side effects and preserves the attempt
cleanup: Drain capture, remove only runner-owned page bindings/scripts/routes/listeners and detach its CDP session; leave browser/context/page open. Driver exit disconnects transport; borrowed-page lifecycle calibration remains required
Retain created conversation identity and failure evidence for separately authorized test-owned cleanup; never delete or retry to conceal an uncertain outcome

steps.trigger: Before blank-document handoff and app navigation, after page-scoped document-start recorder and request guards are installed
steps.action: In the verified existing Edge page, navigate through about:blank to https://prabinpebam.github.io/watai/#/new and await DOMContentLoaded within the same step deadline
steps.expected: The actual designated account reaches the new-conversation shell without redirect loops, stale identity or protected content from another account

capture.start: Before navigation and throughout authentication/bootstrap waits
capture.end: Explicit ready transition or stopped failure
capture.overflow: Stop insufficient on lost events, oversized evidence, unsupported state or undeclared origin; never weaken capture
capture.unexpectedSurface: Fixed sentinel retains safe overlays and stops on unclassified frames/forms or owner ambiguity; no runtime resolution change

regions.reason: Contains the future conversation and its reading position
Any pre-existing message must be visible as a violated initial condition
Primary entry point must become honestly ready
Startup failures and unanticipated overlays are in scope

steps.trigger: The exact composer is visible and the real account verification response is available
steps.action: Require one textarea[aria-label=Message], one button[aria-label=Send], no message nodes and the approved identity/consent/configuration; capture the empty-thread checkpoint
steps.expected: The user is in a genuinely empty owned conversation with a usable composer

capture.start: Before any readiness assertion and during its waits
capture.overflow: Missing identity/coverage/paint is insufficient, not an empty-state success
capture.unexpectedSurface: New message or overlay is retained and stops setup; never clear the state automatically

regions.reason: Establish the initial reading context
Observed empty differs from an omitted region
The exact input and action must be usable
Readiness cannot hide an error or blocking dialog

steps.trigger: Before the real fill action with the complete recorder active
steps.action: Fill exactly: Calculate 17 + 29. Reply with only the decimal integer, without formatting or explanation.
steps.expected: The exact non-sensitive prompt remains in the composer, with Send usable and no submission yet

capture.overflow: Stop insufficient without replaying the action
capture.unexpectedSurface: Unexpected submission, replacement draft or overlay is retained; no input repair within this attempt

regions.reason: Observe unintended navigation or layout movement
Messages appearing before submission are unexpected
Prove the actual submitted input rather than a test variable
Input failures must remain observable

steps.trigger: Before the single real Send click, not after an acceptance predicate succeeds
steps.action: Click the exact Send button once; record whitelisted request clientMessageId/threadId/prompt hash and the real acceptance runId/assistantMessageId. Continue observing pending acceptance until first assistant root or explicit failure
steps.expected: One request is admitted, the submitted prompt persists, and its own first reply never appears before it

capture.start: Before Send and throughout request/acceptance/first-response waits
capture.end: First-response phase or explicit failure; no resubmission
capture.overflow: Any lost interval or unsupported identity handoff is insufficient; known chronology failures remain failures
capture.unexpectedSurface: Unknown optimistic/server alias is never guessed; preserve it as uncorrelated evidence and stop if safety requires

regions.reason: Submission can move or hide the conversation
Every submitted-prompt/first-reply transition is release critical
Feedback must agree with real acceptance
An admitted but unstarted run must not look successfully complete

steps.trigger: First actual assistant root observed while preserving all earlier submit evidence
steps.action: Observe streaming without user action until actual terminal receipt and corresponding terminal UI; mere appearance of the substring46 is not completion
steps.expected: Content grows coherently, remains attached to the same prompt and reaches an honest terminal state
failureModes: Stall or truncated stream claimed complete

capture.end: Actual terminal condition or bounded failure
capture.overflow: Stop insufficient; never shorten the trace or broaden a timing threshold to pass
capture.unexpectedSurface: Retain unexpected tools, content, overlays and identity changes without changing the capture plan

regions.reason: Reading position and visible association matter throughout streaming
Do not reduce the response to an expected integer before recording it
Controls must agree with execution, even without a cancellation action
Progress failure is part of the actual experience

steps.trigger: Actual run terminal receipt and matching terminal UI, with no fabricated expected-answer readiness condition
steps.action: Observe1500 monotonic ms of reconciliation; inspect the actual .md body and structure, capture linked terminal screenshot and record the owned conversation route identity
steps.expected: Exactly46 without formatting/explanation is delivered by the accepted assistant identity; prompt and reply remain visible and ordered

capture.end: After full reconciliation and screenshot, before reload
capture.overflow: Missing handoff, terminal or paint evidence is insufficient and retained
capture.unexpectedSurface: A later correct answer cannot erase an earlier terminal mismatch or disappearance

regions.reason: Completion must not displace the reader
Inspect the actual delivered answer and stable handoff
No stale spinner or misleading terminal action state
An error cannot be hidden by a correct-looking answer

steps.trigger: Before the sole real page reload, after the prior document has a drained checkpoint
steps.action: Reload the same owned conversation once. Capture a new document, fresh HTTP message read with original request phase and pagination completeness, and1500 ms of visible reconciliation; inspect exact persisted prompt/reply and linked screenshot
steps.expected: The same prompt and accepted reply survive actual persistence and reappear in correct order without duplicates or substituted content
failureModes: Stale pre-reload response treated as fresh
Transient reorder or disappearance after restoration

capture.start: Before reload with document continuity and request-phase correlation
capture.end: After fresh-read inspection, reconciliation, screenshot and final drain
capture.overflow: Any missing fresh-read or document/capture evidence is insufficient, never inferred from the visible cache
capture.unexpectedSurface: Wrong route, unrelated records or unknown ownership stop; do not navigate elsewhere or rewrite the evidence

regions.reason: Verify the same conversation and reading context
Fresh persistence, not optimistic display, establishes retention
Reload must leave a coherent usable conversation
A failed reload cannot be silently counted as persistence success

heuristics.algorithm: Require one submission whose fixed prompt hash/thread/clientMessageId match one accepted run; every observed user body equals the fixed prompt and its domainId matches the request. Acceptance alone is not persistence
heuristics.pass: All original observed prompt and request identity facts agree
heuristics.fail: Changed/lost prompt, duplicate submission or wrong binding
negativeCases: Driver flags true with wrong prompt

heuristics.algorithm: Within each actual document retain prompt/reply presence after first observation; require prompt before its own reply in original DOM and geometry at every observed state. Never role-sort. Uncorrelated optimistic assistant ID is insufficient; a wrong terminal ID is failure
heuristics.pass: All calibrated intermediate observations preserve association, presence and order
heuristics.fail: One-state inversion, disappearance, duplicate or wrong terminal association
heuristics.insufficient: Missing frames/geometry or unsupported identity handoff

heuristics.algorithm: Join UI progress to the accepted run's actual lifecycle; require queued/running/terminal consistency and no post-terminal changes without a new action. Stop absence or answer substring is never a terminal oracle
heuristics.pass: Every observed progress and terminal state matches execution and actual delivery
heuristics.fail: Truncated stream or append/start failure claims successful completion
heuristics.insufficient: Safe real lifecycle receipts or exact transition oracle unavailable

heuristics.algorithm: At terminal and reload, trim only leading/trailing whitespace and compare actual body exactly with46; reject formatting/explanation and wrong terminal reply identity. Never compare wrapper text containing copy controls
heuristics.pass: The exact actual unformatted46 belongs to the accepted reply
heuristics.fail: Wrong, hidden, formatted or substituted answer
negativeCases: Correct hidden value behind wrong visible output

inputs: fresh HTTP message read originated during reload
heuristics.algorithm: Require a new document and actual reload-phase complete HTTP read for the accepted thread containing exactly one expected user and assistant identity with exact prompt and46 content; then match actual rendered restoration. A prior optimistic or pre-reload read never qualifies
heuristics.pass: Fresh persistence and visible restoration agree exactly

heuristics.algorithm: Require visible unclipped messages and usable exact controls, approved typography/assets and preserved reading anchor throughout each transition; reference values and pixel thresholds must be independently bound before completion
heuristics.pass: Actual paint and interactions satisfy the approved reference in every required phase
heuristics.fail: Hidden/covered primary result, clipped action or displaced reader
heuristics.insufficient: Approved reference, genuine pixels or full focus/scroll evidence absent
heuristics.implementation: PARTIAL:message visibility checks; independent DS/scroll/paint qualification missing

heuristics.algorithm: Require the exact seven-phase order, contiguous receiver/document records, one Send/POST, every required interval/asset and normal drain; preserve reliable product failures even if later capture fails. Unreached stale/pending/multi-session branches never count as covered
heuristics.pass: Complete calibrated evidence within the fixed task envelope
heuristics.fail: Extra submission or unauthorized side effect; preserve independently observed defects
heuristics.insufficient: Any omitted channel, phase, branch, receipt, artifact or drain
negativeCases: Capture gap after visible wrong result

semantic.contextExhaustion: Preflight must establish lossless capacity for the full capture envelope; exhaustion or omitted windows means insufficient and never prompts improvised compaction
semantic.findingContract: Inspect every original window and required asset independently of heuristic conclusions, then synthesize the whole experience. Discover novel anomalies without a detector ID; cite original events/assets and separate observation, expectation, impact and uncertainty. Durable journal acknowledgement is mandatory before dispatch and completion
